name: Python booking app
summary: Fern Studio, a class-booking app in two parts: a SvelteKit site on a FastAPI JSON API. Browse the timetable, pay with Stripe Checkout, get a confirmation through Resend, see your bookings. Postgres through psycopg.
runsOn: A FastAPI API started with uv and a SvelteKit site on Node, in Chromium, with Postgres in Docker
shows: Two apps in two languages behind one proxy: stackEnvironment starts the API, then the site, and wires each to the other's address
An app outside Node behind danwo's proxy: the official Stripe and Resend Python SDKs reach the emulators through the proxy and CA variables danwo sets, with no test hooks
Every hop on the record: the browser, the SvelteKit server calling the API, the browser calling the API, and the API calling Stripe and Resend
Invariants that read Postgres against Stripe and Resend: one booking per paid session, one confirmation per booking, amounts equal to what Stripe charged
`danwo matrix` faulting Stripe, Resend, the webhooks and Postgres itself (54 trials), and the app surviving every one
A `STUDIO_BUG` switch that turns one safeguard off, so you can watch the matrix catch it
